opinions.text:
Per Curiam.
Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of Andrews v. Swartz, 156 U. S. 272; Frank v. Mangum, 237 U. S. 309.
opinions.author: Per Curiam.

No. 672.
Robert Kitchens, Appellant, v. J. C. Hamilton, Sheriff, etc.

Argued January 11, 1916.
Decided January 17, 1916.
Mr. John R. Cooper for the appellant. Mr. Clifford Walker for the appellee.
